bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 4” x 6” x 1.5” are prohibited, except for certain exceptions. Single compartment bags, wallets, clutches, fanny packs, and clear bags smaller than the specified size are allowed.
allowed: clear bags smaller than 4" x 6" x 1.5"
prohibited: Apparel with vulgar, obscene, profane, or discriminatory messages
Banners, signs, flags larger than 11” x 17”
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags, parenting bags, and medical bags required for dietary or medical necessity smaller than 16" x 16" x 8" are permitted.

parking.note: Parking is available around Little Caesars Arena with various lots and garages offering different pricing options. It is recommended to arrive early to secure a spot, especially during major events.

rideshare.note: Use westbound Fisher Service Drive next to the UWM Garage for rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: Little Caesars Arena offers a variety of food options including arena classics, chicken dishes, grilled items, and signature Little Caesars pizza. There are also pop-up stands and four in-venue restaurants, providing diverse choices for attendees.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call - Located within the Box Office on Woodward Avenue. Will Call is located at the Fox Theatre Box Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrances include the Chevrolet Entrance on the northeast side and the Comerica Entrance on the southeast side.
